Author: Elk
Name: Elk's RP Mounts Anywhere
Punchline: Mount anywhere, stay in style — cosmetic RP mounts with Moodles sync.
Description: Bring your favorite mounts into your RP scenes, even in cities and interiors! Use mounts from your shortcut bars, browse your collection, save favorites and create macros. Modded mounts are supported too, and you can share cosmetic appearances with friends through Moodles and compatible sync tools. Available in English and French. No extra speed or flight.
